verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's docs explicitly describe automated PR code review with contextual feedback, suggested fixes, and severity labeling (High/Medium/Low) for prioritization, plus 'Access to Cloud agent and code review' as a plan feature. This directly matches the story's request for automatic, contextual PR review feedback. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community evidence specifically validating the PR-review feature's accuracy or usefulness (community citations mostly discuss code completion, not the review feature) and detail on review-triggering automation reliability.
